mxGraphModel.root:
<UserObject label="" mermaidData="{"data": "sequenceDiagram
 autonumber
 actor User as User
 participant WebUI as Web UI
 participant Backend as Backend API
 participant ReportRepo as Annual Report Repo
 participant NewsRepo as News Repo
 participant Preprocess as ESG Preprocessor
 participant ViDeBERTa as ViDeBERTa Classifier
 participant GraphRAG as Graph-RAG Pipeline
 participant Gemini as Gemini 2.5 Flash
 participant ER as Entity Resolver
 participant Neo4j as Neo4j Graph DB
 participant Crosscheck as Cross-check Engine
 participant LLMAdj as LLM Adjudicator
 participant DossierGen as Dossier Generator
 participant DB as System DB

 rect rgb(245, 247, 250)
 note over User, DB: Phase 1: Request Initialization & Data Ingestion
 User->>WebUI: 1. Select company & request analysis
 activate WebUI
 WebUI->>Backend: 2. Send request (POST /api/analyze)
 activate Backend
 
 par Concurrent Data Fetching
 Backend->>ReportRepo: 3a. Fetch Annual Reports
 activate ReportRepo
 ReportRepo-->>Backend: Return report text
 deactivate ReportRepo
 and
 Backend->>NewsRepo: 3b. Fetch ESG News
 activate NewsRepo
 NewsRepo-->>Backend: Return news articles
 deactivate NewsRepo
 end

 Backend->>Preprocess: 4. Invoke preprocessing
 activate Preprocess
 Preprocess->>Preprocess: 5. Extract text & segment
 Preprocess-->>Backend: Return candidate sentences
 deactivate Preprocess

 Backend->>ViDeBERTa: 6. Send candidate sentences
 activate ViDeBERTa
 ViDeBERTa->>ViDeBERTa: 7. Classify E/S/G/Neutral
 ViDeBERTa-->>Backend: 8. Return ESG sentences
 deactivate ViDeBERTa
 end

 rect rgb(240, 248, 245)
 note over User, DB: Phase 2: Graph Construction & Entity Resolution
 Backend->>GraphRAG: 9. Invoke Graph-RAG Pipeline
 activate GraphRAG
 
 alt Alt Flow 2 (Failover): Gemini Unavailable
 GraphRAG->>LLMAdj: 10a. Failover call (GPT-4o-mini)
 activate LLMAdj
 LLMAdj-->>GraphRAG: 11a. Return extractions
 deactivate LLMAdj
 else Primary Provider Available: Gemini 2.5 Flash
 GraphRAG->>Gemini: 10. Extract entities & KPIs
 activate Gemini
 Gemini-->>GraphRAG: 11. Return extractions
 deactivate Gemini
 end

 GraphRAG->>ER: 12. Invoke Entity Resolver
 activate ER
 opt Alt Flow 3: Duplicate Entities Found
 ER->>ER: Merge duplicates into
canonical entity
 end
 ER->>ER: 13. Canonicalize names &
stamp provenance
 ER-->>GraphRAG: Return resolved graph
 deactivate ER

 GraphRAG->>Neo4j: 14. Insert clean graph
 activate Neo4j
 Neo4j-->>GraphRAG: Confirm insertion
 deactivate Neo4j
 GraphRAG-->>Backend: Construction complete
 deactivate GraphRAG
 end

 rect rgb(250, 245, 240)
 note over User, DB: Phase 3: Dual Retrieval & LLM Cross-checking
 Backend->>Crosscheck: 15. Invoke Cross-check Engine
 activate Crosscheck
 Crosscheck->>Neo4j: 16-17. Retrieve claim & conduct nodes
 activate Neo4j
 Neo4j-->>Crosscheck: Return claims, KPIs & news
 deactivate Neo4j

 alt Alt Flow 1: No Relevant News Found
 Crosscheck->>LLMAdj: Send claim with empty context
 activate LLMAdj
 LLMAdj-->>Crosscheck: Return unverified + caveats
 deactivate LLMAdj
 else Evidence Found: Cross-check Adjudication
 Crosscheck->>LLMAdj: 18. Send claim & evidence
 activate LLMAdj
 LLMAdj-->>Crosscheck: 19-20. Return assessment & rationale
 deactivate LLMAdj
 end

 Crosscheck->>Neo4j: 21. Write verifiedBy / contradictedBy
 activate Neo4j
 Neo4j-->>Crosscheck: Confirm edges written
 deactivate Neo4j

 Crosscheck->>DossierGen: 22. Request Dossier creation
 activate DossierGen
 DossierGen->>DossierGen: Assemble Dossier
 DossierGen-->>Crosscheck: Complete Dossier
 deactivate DossierGen
 Crosscheck-->>Backend: Return Dossier
 deactivate Crosscheck

 Backend->>DB: 23. Save Dossier
 activate DB
 DB-->>Backend: Saved confirmation
 deactivate DB

 Backend-->>WebUI: 24. Return Dossier
 deactivate Backend

 WebUI->>WebUI: 25. Visualize Evidence Dossier
 WebUI-->>User: 26. Display Dossier for analyst review
 deactivate WebUI
 end", "config": null}" id="GraphRAG_Sequence_Node">
